WITH v AS (SELECT t.name AS territory, t.territory_id, t.territory_group, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS viewers, ROUND(SUM(ps.total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS watch_hours FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = ps.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = ps.subscriber_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON t.territory_id = s.territory_id WHERE e.title_id = 1 GROUP BY t.name, t.territory_id, t.territory_group), w AS (SELECT territory_id, COUNT(*) AS windows_total, SUM(CASE WHEN active_flag AND availability_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_windows, SUM(CASE WHEN active_flag AND availability_status = 'Active' AND NOT blackout_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_no_blackout, SUM(CASE WHEN blackout_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blackout_windows, ARRAY_JOIN(COLLECT_SET(CONCAT(window_type, ':', availability_status, CASE WHEN active_flag THEN '/open' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN blackout_flag THEN '/blackout' ELSE '' END, ' ', CAST(window_open_date AS STRING), '→', COALESCE(CAST(window_close_date AS STRING), 'perpetual'))), '; ') AS details FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE title_id = 1 GROUP BY territory_id) SELECT v.territory, v.territory_group, v.sessions, v.viewers, v.watch_hours, COALESCE(w.windows_total, 0) AS windows_total, COALESCE(w.active_windows, 0) AS active_windows, COALESCE(w.active_no_blackout, 0) AS active_no_blackout, COALESCE(w.blackout_windows, 0) AS blackout_windows, w.details FROM v LEFT JOIN w ON w.territory_id = v.territory_id ORDER BY v.sessions DESC LIMIT 1000
